Big emotions already with the smallest runners

"My resolution for the new year is: I will no longer eat dumplings and no more roast meat – for breakfast." "Because it's warm, the animals suffer under their thick fur. I know that because I have the winter fat all year." "Djokovic is now allowed to go to the Australian Open unvaccinated. That's not a Grand Slam, but a Grand Mess." "Many students are already looking forward to Latin again next Monday. Then hopefully Ovid instead of Covid." "The vaccination mandate should only be technically feasible from April. Many will now think that this is certainly an early April fool's joke." "I also wrote a poem for Djokovic: Roses are red. Violets are blue. Without vaccination to Australia: That is not smart." "Corona – and no end in sight: Who is surprised that my mood falls with the temperatures. And indeed into the double-digit minus range." "Humans have a heart transplanted from a piglet. I can't eat schnitzel so nicely anymore, could be an organ donor." "Now the experts are needed. An expert is someone who says what comes, and if it doesn't come that way, where it comes from that it comes differently." "Johnson is increasingly discredited because of parties in lockdown. For a hairdresser visit, people would surely have more understanding." "I know a strong vaccination incentive. If our education minister would say: If you all get vaccinated, then I will go to the hairdresser." "Today the thousandth millionaire show runs. The one who becomes millionaire is already known: Armin Assinger." "The après-ski party in Kitz is a real joke! Too bad we can’t vaccinate against stupidity." "A trick filmmaker from FH Hagenberg was already twice on Oscar course. I believe he could even animate me to move." “With the vaccine mandate, the police should check whether someone hasn’t done something he should have done. That’s then not a course of events (act), but a course of non-events (inaction).” “The living room tests are mostly cellar tests for me.” “Who would have believed that Omicron would become so bad that our officials can no longer keep track of the infected with their teeth.” “When VdB is once again, after the second term he’s almost as old as all the chancellors he has vowed to.” “I wonder when the pandemic will finally become an endemic – or will it never end?” “Who still has to scream after Gabalier and Parov Stelar so that people understand internet scamming? Mozart?” “In Schladming, Dave Ryding didn’t win. At least he doesn’t have to be afraid that Boris Johnson will come to celebrate.” “156.000 euros did the politician animal study cost. Now everyone wants to be the responsible innocent lamb.” “In the Buwog judgment, the judge wrote 1280 pages in 420 days. I already become pale with a shopping list.” “Soon unvaccinated people will be allowed back to the pub – but if the police stop you on the way home, you’ll be punished for the vaccine mandate. That’s what I call logic.” “If a few herbs in the refrigerator have a climate effect, then we can also mix that into our breakfast muesli.” “The SPÖ really caught huge side effects with their vaccination campaign.” “No one can understand the rules for the Green Pass anymore. Maybe the government will explain them to us in a side letter.” “The difference between Facebook and me? The one breaks after 15 years. I am still thick after 50 years.” “Anyone who doesn’t have at least five rings under their eyes the next day is not a true Olympic fan.” “Some students are demonstrating against the oral Matura. That is a new form of class struggle.” “Now that the pope ‘quotenkaiser’ (ratings emperor) is on television, I’ll watch him at Gottsnäm next time with Gottschalk.” “Matthias Mayer now has three Olympic golds: 3G, which I will never be able to prove.” “From Saturday on, I can no longer tell vaccinated from unvaccinated: Then everyone will have nice hair again.” “Luge was my Olympic sport. How to lie flat on your back and try not to bump into anything, I train every Sunday.” “Trump disposed of documents he didn’t like in the toilet. That gives ‘round file’ a whole new meaning.” “Weddings in the woods are popular now. I just hope no one has the idea to leave the in-laws there immediately to spare themselves the trouble.” “Thank God I don’t have a home office throat, I’m more likely to get a sore throat because this Corona doesn’t stop.” “Paintings are divided into thousands of digital parts to make money. Everyday the total artwork is printed, I am priceless!” “Instead of the vaccine lottery, maybe there’s now a vaccine mandate quiz: Who knows when it will be over again?” “One thing you have to give Boris Johnson: His standing power is greater than that of all our domestic politics.” “A study proved: You gain weight when sleeping – I’ll stay in bed all weekend. Because the Lord takes his own in sleep.” “When canoe sprint becomes Olympic (again), we have a fixed gold medal with Mückstein.” “When partying, I do it like Pumuckl, who says on his 60th: ‘I come back to the world more often because I like partying so much!’” “Putin is not only standing with a rifle at his feet, but also with the truth at war’s feet.” “Now you have to watch out more for fake vaccination certificates than for fake money: That doesn’t pay off anymore with inflation.” “‘I am the complete idiot’ – Sabine Beinschab said that during her confession. In a poll she gets 100 percent approval.” “Quick poll after Frau Beinschab’s confession: Who wants Basti back?” “I don’t understand that opticians are doing business like this now. I prefer not to look so closely at what’s happening.” “Now it’s been stated that our ‘Venus of Willendorf’ comes from Italy. That leaves only one domestic original for us.” "Fifa excludes all Russian clubs. So Putin has cleverly put his team offside." "Apparently Sobotka believes that just because he is a conductor, he can turn the tone up and down as he wishes in the investigative committee." "Fasting means renunciation. That's why I just got the jab for 40 days." "When a politician now says he doesn't believe in polls, I immediately think: He knows what he's talking about!" "When I look at the faces in discos on weekends, it's clear: that's where the coronavirus is in high spirits." "For today's Women's Day, I give the floor to the Mostdipfin – and with that I'm already quiet." "Experts say after Corona we should slowly start exercising again. And what do I do if I haven't moved before?" "Bayern against Soizburg 7:1. I just say: Dear players of the Dos’n, that went into the pants." "The corona numbers are rising just like fuel prices." "Now I know what the government understands by evidence-based corona measures: Close your eyes and get through it." "I wanted to go refueling. In the end, I exchanged my car against ten liters of diesel." "My wife and I are already experiencing our third (Corona) spring this year." "The first electricity saving measure I took yesterday was turning off the TV during ‘SOKO Linz’." "Now there are as many positive people as never before. If it wasn't because of Corona, it was positive anyway." "What I would most like to do with the Saharan dust on my car? Send it to the desert." "When it comes to lifting driving restrictions, the government must soon get moving, otherwise the fuel will become ridiculously cheap." "My spring feelings aren't really different than in winter, summer, or autumn: hunger and thirst." "Chocolate banana is the ice cream of the year. Way too sweet for me. I was hoping for a pear-apple cider double lick." "Tomorrow Austria plays against Wales. I hope Arnautovic has really read it and doesn't turn towards WSC/Hertha-Plotz in Wels." "Now we have to put on masks again or not, or be vaccinated or tested or not: The government has issued a new confusion." "The drafting of the new quarantine regulation now takes longer than the quarantine itself." "I fully and completely understand our soccer players. I won’t let myself be sent into the desert either." "Now we have to change our clocks again. Too bad, I actually liked it better where it was." "Dominc Thiem would wish for a forehand like Will Smith's at the Oscars during his comeback." "Now that Foda is gone, the eight million virologists in Austria will finally be eight million team coaches again." "The game against Scotland was supposed to be a test for our footballers. But we don't know: positive or negative." g‘lost.“ "That would be the turning point in Austrian style if the party affiliation no longer played a role in the allocation of posts." "FC Bayern is apparently not satisfied with its fans: That's why they got the 12. Let them just play along." "For our neighbors, this Easter greeting again means: Urbi et Orban!" "In England, 60 people got sick after eating the surprise eggs. There's never been a bigger surprise for children." "The doctors now had a choice. At least with them you can assume that it's really only every five years." "To conjure a smile from flowers – whoever always had the idea for that, I sprinkle roses here." "The government now has to find the tree where the money grows that's currently so merrily being spent." "My wife says that I replace every pet for her: I growl like a dog in the morning, swear like a parrot, and come home as late as a cat." "Completely in the spirit of a healthy lifestyle: Because I am too heavy, my Easter basket will remain empty this year." "Doskozil calls Gabalier the spring stone of Austria. There are politicians who have already had to resign for a few stupid remarks." "There is gossip that Nehammer wants a new party color for the ÖVP. But he doesn't know yet: Dark turquoise, or light black." "For now, we only have the mask requirement, thanks to Elon Musk, Twitter will soon have a musket requirement." "Tomorrow's lotto is for four million euros. I hope the Easter Bunny puts the right numbers in my nest." Since yesterday I can forget the Easter ham, but now I have to eat asparagus every day." "When I heard that Hermann Nitsch died, I almost spilled something." "The difference between schnapps and vaccination: With schnapps I know how many shots I need, with the vaccine no one tells me yet." "How do I plant my potatoes? I always tell you they are carrots." "Ring toss or beer tent? Next week at the Urfahr market I'll probably again not know what to do first." "The CSI wastewater now investigates more strongly in Vienna because of Corona. We can only wish them bad noses." "Falstaff has again awarded the best cooks in the land. I've been waiting for years to be honored as the best eater sometime." "Musk buys Twitter to protect freedom of speech. That's like me drinking so I sober up." "What I will do against the pension shock, I don't know yet. Citizen masters, that's not such a good idea." "Everything gets more expensive. Only my jokes stay cheap." "I think the right punishment for Boris Becker was two and a half years of waiting on the lawn at Wimbledon." "I didn't notice much from my matriculation, except what Sokrates said — that I know that I know nothing." "It is said that one should not mow the lawn in May — that makes the bees happy — and me even more." "An ex-Rapid fan becomes LASK coach. Many Linz fans will turn green with envy and white in the face." "Pilnacek against WKStA: In justice it gets rough, against that Simmering against Kapfenberg is a cuddle fight." "LASK starts selling subscriptions for the new stadium already on Monday. Somehow you have to finance Kühbauer." "At least that's what the weather says, next week the ice men will invite us for ice cream." "We should consume less for environmental protection? Then I am a role model. I buy nothing myself: My wife brings everything." "As often as Van der Bellen has to swear in new ministers, he doesn't even have more time to light a cigarette in between." "Today kids get fat because a lot of unhealthy things are advertised on the net. For me that worked without Instagram and Facebook too." "One new minister was not at the swearing-in. No fear, just because of corona and not because he already resigned again." "I don't care how Ried against LASK turns out tomorrow. The main thing is the fans stay calm and don't score an own goal." "It is said that the Federal President wishes for a swearing-in app for ministers, so he can have more peace in the Hofburg." "If it finally gets swimming at the end of the week, I'll finally have a day off again. As I always say: better to swim in the lake than in the bathtub." "The washboard abs won’t happen again this year — but in summer I really gained a lot of weight." "Compared to Amber against Johnny, Simmering against Kapfenberg is a friendly match." "I think I know how the Linz tech university should go: So that from fewer and fewer subjects you know more and more, until you know everything from none." "I don't understand why everyone congratulates Oliver Glasner on his biggest victory now. He already won the most dip 2017." "I am a bit disappointed by the TikTok video of the Federal President. At least he could have sung if he didn't want to dance." "At the Upper Austrian Ball in Vienna, Mayor Ludwig blessed where Bartl gets the must: from Innviertel." "Stadl-Paura wants to become a town. At least the name is quite easy: They should just call themselves Stadtl-Paura." "In Austria, masks disappear quickly, just like at the carnival in Venice. Hopefully, the water won't soon be up to the house." "Bernie Ecclestone has been arrested. For weapons possession. I would have bet on organizing illegal car races." "They're saying again that this is the last tour of the Rolling Stones. I’ll only believe it when Jagger needs a rollator." "Now the Schuin Heans also start with the corona tests again. Now we’ll be rejoicing over every positive result again." "A farm shop is a good thing. Sad that for some farm shops it means something else." "The Queen has sat on the throne for 70 years. I don’t have that much endurance, I always immediately fall asleep on my butt." "Masks can come again in autumn, says Minister Rauch. I can already guess exactly when: on 11. 11., at 11 o'clock 11." "ÖBB customers have it good: They can enjoy their lives to the fullest." "Next week Johnson will say that he knew nothing about the party for the Queen and that he was not there." Flights are canceled, trains go crazy, traffic jams on the roads. I’m staying home and having a vacation at the Kirchawirt." "Rangnick is a magician: power outage, lost against Denmark – and still everyone has fun." "Who else is running for the Hofburg election? Certainly not me: I am always a candidate for fun, but never a fun candidate." "ElTschiBiTiKjuAiEi – no, I didn't fall asleep on the keyboard. But when it comes to vape, then I speak English too." "A hot tip for everyone who doesn't have a Father's Day gift yet: a six-pack comes surely better than a tie." "Physicists say: light is both a wave and a particle. The Seniors' Association is similar: it is simultaneously part of the ÖVP and not." "I'm also applying for the presidency. Because if the boss of the Beer Party counts on a chance, I as Mostdipf might win one too." "The reprimand that Rangnick gave his top players was a sound cloud of a very special kind." "My neighbor says he has a new idea for saving electricity and gas: he’s flying on vacation for three weeks now." "Now we are building a two-million lift in Linz Castle Hill. For that money, we would probably have gotten a half-theater ten years ago 20." "Luckily, in this heat I only sit in the checkered garden. With my figure, I need two hours just to get dressed." "Today William celebrates his 40th. Hopefully he’s got control at the party and doesn't fall out of the prince role." "In England, the railways are on strike and want to cause traffic chaos. Or as the ÖBB says: a completely normal day on the West Railway line." "The new energy mix goes like this: with the gasoline price, you have to turn down the gas so that there’s still coal for electricity." "Martin Hinteregger is quitting. The question is only whether his farewell party lasts days, weeks, or months." "The Dutch king is coming here on Monday. I’m interested whether he comes by bike or with a caravan." "Planes don't fly, we’re kicked off the train and with the car you're stuck in traffic. I'd rather stay home, it's best there." "Prince Charles is said to have taken money in a suitcase. Do we also know this from a chat of Thomas Schmid?" "I really know a great Tour de France joke – but I won’t ride the bike." "What a great state visit from the Dutch royal couple! They could even guarantee Mayor Ludwig from Vienna that they are the real ones." "With this high inflation, you should be glad that my jokes are so cheap." "I know what sustainable fashion is already for a long time. I have been wearing my green vest for 52 years and it still looks good." "If the gas runs out, we will build a turbine into the parliament and cover the electricity need with hot air." "I don’t care where the borscht comes from, the main thing is I get a shot of vodka with my cabbage soup." "I don’t need a referee to know: Anyone who thinks female football players should earn less money than men is offside." "Cash register fusions are expensive, I noticed that myself. I combined the household cash with the one for the pub, and soon everything was gone." "The question is not whether Boris Johnson will celebrate his farewell with a party. But only whether he will do it legally or illegally." "A spot in British history books is certain for Johnson: He is the Prime Minister who has spent the least money on haircuts." "'What's common between men and the weather?' my wife asked me over the weekend. I replied: 'Neither one do they let change!'" "Hobby horse riding is now called Hobby-Horsing. If that's so, then I'm off now to Cider- Drinking." "The light we see on the world-space buildings has been traveling for 13 billion years. One might think ÖBB is responsible for the transport." "We already have a price cap: Gewessler said one should put a lid on when cooking, then it's cheaper." "I can't really believe those 19 degrees in the office in winter. Hot air often comes from Brussels." "Kickl is last in the trust index among politicians. But only because no Red has asked." "A gas price cap, an electricity price cap, and a public transport price cap – that'll give you an old tongue twister ... the Ödögö-cap" "Swinging is supposed to be so healthy, says research. Great, then I won't have to have a guilty conscience when I stagger home from the pub." "If they still need someone at the pavement spectacle from tomorrow, I’d be the sweat pearl juggler." "The Brits get a new Prime Minister: About time, because politically Johnson was looking as ragged as his hair recently." "Constantly Corona waves, plus a wave of price increases, now a heat wave. And soon we'll have politician waves again." "Next week, temperatures will drop below thirty degrees. It'll probably be time to light the wood stove." "Helene Fischer is now back from baby leave. The nights were probably more about sleep than breathlessness." "Apparently there are so many mushrooms at Heia that even I can easily enter the Champions League." "The perpetually young miniskirt turns sixty. I tried one on – no, it doesn’t fit." "When infected teachers go to school, students will probably wish for the first time that they don't test positive." "Now that Vettel will soon no longer be driving laps, he will surely draw one or another lap in farewell." "I know about energy saving: Put the phone away, put your feet up and enjoy the weekend!" "Wild boars retreat into the mud when it's too hot for them. If they get 34 degrees now, I’ll think about it too." "My favorite Italian is considering a new dish for his menu: Farfalle con Qualle." "If Rita Falk can no longer think of titles, I can help. How about 'Most Homicide', 'Schnitzel Slaughter' or 'Tofu Chaos'?" "The leg itch has obviously unpacked properly. It’s possible that a few can pack soon because of it." "Earlier we threatened kids with house arrest. Today we just take their phone away for three hours." "No wonder so many kids can’t swim. You can’t swim properly with a phone in your hand." "20 years ago, they said in Upper Austria: No matter how high the water rises, the level of helpfulness is higher." "I have a solution for the ice cube crisis in Spain: Send us some sangria and we’ll sell it as mulled wine in winter." "Trump is said to have taken files from the White House. Probably he didn’t understand them at first reading and so packed them." "Now even a Waldviertel factory owner wants to become president – it might well be that he takes off his shoes in the process." "Doskozil said 'yes' over the weekend. But only because he's getting married and not because he's talking with the federal SPÖ." "Alaba won the Supercup. With the goal and that performance, the dream of the perfect season could become reality." "The current balance figures Rosenbauer delivers fit very well with the fire trucks they build there." "In Krankl they caught him now in Linz. From 'Goleador' he turned into 'Hans in Misfortune'." "The Gecko-General will be new Chief of Staff. Good that they found him at all, considering he always wears a camouflage suit." "9 percent more than last year: Well, I'm not talking about inflation now, but about my weight." "Soon we'll find out how the gas is going to be distributed when there's not enough for everyone. Hopefully the companies won’t have to skimp on gas." "Instead of paying the bill, I’m now bailing out a gas supplier. That was enough back in the day for the nurses." "Van der Bellen had a slip-up in the election campaign – but only while hiking. That won’t cost him any votes." "Inflation keeps rising. The start of school doesn’t cost parents just nerves, but also a lot of money." "I’m not as at risk as the Finnish prime minister. Maybe someone can catch me drinking cider, but definitely not while dancing!" "I’m curious whether the bonus will be enough to improve the climate between voters and politics." "Who would have thought there would be more candidates for Federal President than for a job as a bus driver." '“What do women and men have in common?”, my wife asked me. “When they get divorced, it can still be a nice day,” she said and opened the door for me.' "Saving electricity is the motto – we certainly won’t let the light at the end of the tunnel be switched off on us." "Vienna Energy has retrofitted its power plants. Now they burn Styrian gold instead of gas." "I think Ludwig didn’t know correctly who he should be talking to about Vienna Energy. He no longer wanted to phone Klitschko." "Putin is not going to Gorbachev's funeral. Nice that he’s still making Gorbi happy posthumously." "Nice weather this weekend? Good that we still have the high electricity prices, otherwise there’d be nothing to complain about." "A green vest is timelessly beautiful, you can wear it everywhere. That’s where the colleague above me and I agree." "Cirrus, stratus or cumulus – I’m only afraid of the thunderclouds over my wife’s head when I come home late." "Boris Johnson has assured his successor 'energetic support.' Such a mean threat should even be avoided in politics." "The government says the electricity price brakes are a bit inaccurate because it was drawn that way. That worked in school during copying too." "For politics good on electricity price: Either a cap or at the next election there’ll be one on the head." "Now all kinds of price caps are being demanded. I hope someone soon thinks of cider." "500 euros are given to everyone as a climate bonus. For the climate in the government, however, the bonus now becomes a malus." "For the start of school, we’re missing tablets, says my landlord. He talks easily, he has a whole bunch of them." "The Queen is dead. Or as the mockers say: A 73-year-old now has the first job in his life." "For some jobs, there are no applicants for open positions. One of them is the ÖVP General Secretary." "If the ski slopes really get narrower, then it’ll get really tight for me." "In Munich today begins the Oktoberfest. There they celebrate the money devaluation with 13 euro 80 for a Maß of beer." "I thank sincerely for bread and cider apples – because I prefer drinking a light fruit cider." "You can have a belly, the main thing is you move," says fit Philipp. "Seen like this, I do everything right: I always walk to the tavern." "Winter will be cold. But as long as there are people like the lifesavers in the hardware store, my heart stays warm." "The ÖVP parliamentary club went on a pilgrimage to Sonntagberg. Maybe they thought now all that’s left is to pray." "My wife complains about my un-ironed shirts. But that’s my contribution to energy saving." "Tomorrow something like a slide could come in Tirol halfway. The weather has nothing to do with it exceptionally." "Hopefully the Tirol election doesn’t wreck football. Then the football players soon will say after every defeat: a super comeback." "That suits Italy – to elect such a step!" "The shops in PlusCity soon won’t be able to turn on electricity anymore. When the light goes out, shopping night gets a bad aftertaste." “Nord Stream has holes: Now it won’t be long until someone demands a gas cap there.” Go leak.” “The government is watching us. We should indeed turn the heating down in winter, but then we’re allowed to drive boats by floodlight.” “53 Euro costs half a litre of beer in the festival tent at Oktoberfest. That means for the wallet: O’zapft is!” “One must no longer say Old woman’s summer, so I wish everyone a wonderful golden October today.” “As handsome as I am, they should give me the Physics Nobel Prize. Then Zeilinger can pack it in.” “I’m happy about Zeilinger’s Nobel Prize. Less so when I go shopping, then I think: Nobel, the prize.” “For Alfons Schuhbeck it now means District Court instead of favorite dish. You can be sure nothing works with preserves there.” “Nowadays you often hear talk of the golden October. I believe that phrase was invented by the oil multinationals.” “With electricity prices, at the St. Martin’s festival one will sing: ‘The light goes out in my home. Rabimmel, rabammel rabumm.’” “Richard Lugner could open a kind of Gut Aiderbichl at his 90th – for Mausi, Katzi, Spatzi, Bambi, Zebra …” “The Finance Minister is presenting a crisis budget in his speech today. Like me, when my wife was away for a few days.” “Speaking of Wallentin: I’m glad that Tassilo’s cup passed us by.” “Cold season, Corona wave and almost no one enjoys the masks anymore. No wonder the virologists are so snuffly.” “Next week it will be 25 degrees. If I had known that, I wouldn’t have put away my shorts yet.” “Mitterlehner was also at the Tarock Cup. That is still honest because there is only a 'king-call' and no 'king-murder' like it was called back when he resigned.” “This weekend is the Linz Marathon. I’m not fit enough – but every day my joke runs.” “Schmid wants to become a crown witness or, as he wrote in the chat: ‘I love my public prosecutor’s office.’” “You’re always learning. Now I had to experience that the Langbathsee is a reservoir.” “The British government will be rebuilt again in six weeks. Or as we say: everyday life.” “At that theatre in London, many EU politicians think that Brexit wasn’t so bad.” “15 Prime Ministers served under the late Queen. If it goes on like this, King Charles will have done it by New Year.” “‘Get me out of the sun,’ my wife often says to me. Today that doesn’t help her because today it’s not me but the moon.” “The government promised on National Day that it will work for the people. I hope so for them, otherwise even they will soon be unemployed.” “More than a hundred plants grow only in Austria. Surely the two-rooted are among them too.” “‘The bird is free,’ Elon Musk said about his takeover of Twitter. Did he look at himself in the mirror while saying that?” “I have a new farmer’s rule: If October is too warm, you can save well on heating.” “At the Halloween riots there were a bunch of pumpkin heads – and not even a little lantern was burning in the upper room.” “Let’s see if Schmid really comes to the investigative committee today. Or whether he thinks a chat is enough, because he’s good at that.” “Bananas are supposed to help against Corona. I fear they will become the new toilet paper.” “I knew that André Heller is a handful in all streets. That he is also a busy handyman was new to me.” “Because it’s too warm, they now have to cancel the giant slalom in Lech/Zürs. Maybe the FIS will soon hold water ski races.” “Snowdrops are already blooming in my garden – hopefully they will ring in the winter.” “FIFA is snuffly because of the criticism of the soccer World Cup. Hopefully they don’t get catarrh.” “The OÖNachrichten are looking for the best dumpling recipes. My advice: Look for the best dumpling eaters, then I can join in too.” "The Låndeshauptmånn has declared Wels the fool's capital. He only dares to do that during Fasching." "Actually, we should be happy about the shipping, but now the Footb-“oi” World Cup has come in between." "Instead of the red wave, the Republicans in America have now probably received a black eye." "A businessman from Hong Kong paid 184.000 euros for a truffle. I think he must have eaten crazy mushrooms." "King Charles is quoted in the book by Prince Harry. Potter Harry was surely dearer to him." "A piano comes into parliament for 3000 euros a month. I'm curious if the next thing will be the opening of the Wolfgang-Sobotka concert hall." "I don't know what will be more frightening this weekend: the first Perchten runs or the first game of the World Cup." "On Saturday morning I didn't trust my eyes when I looked out the window. And now there is already snow from yesterday." "The government is lucky that finance is not a company. Otherwise, it would be among the candidates for a chance profit increase in the first row." "Advent will certainly be a round thing for me, because my wife already started baking cookies yesterday." "Thanks to the Advent series, I now know how to make cookies sustainably. Cookies that I will accept in all forms." "I would be the first sticker activist: years ago I often stayed stuck at the inn." "Sometimes I wonder how long the referees will still let the game go on at the World Cup? A thousand and one nights?" "The question stings me every year anew: What does a vegetarian actually eat on bratwurst Sunday?" "If your life always goes according to plan, you also ride well with the train." "That was a novelty: In all of Austria, not a single train was delayed." "You know what: Today I’m striking once. No jokes." "For a football World Cup in December I tear myself about as much as for Christmas cookies after 6. January." "Australia is not Austria. Unfortunately, that also applies to the round of 16 at the football World Cup. They are in. We watch." "When you go for a night stroll, they say why one needs an electricity price brake: for the Christmas lighting." "In memoriam Mundl: My beer is not stupid! So, now I drink my best cider to him. Karl Merkatz, eternally unforgettable." Virus Mostdipf.“ "Hermann Maier turns 50 years old today like Goldi. What else do they have in common? Both became famous for ski flying. Maier not quite voluntarily." "The state government suspends debt buildup. I made the decision for my finances long ago." "The next days will show us that winter still exists. But no fear, it will surely be warm again at Christmas." "In Qatar, you don't know anything about corruption. Neither because of the EU nor because of FIFA. Here it runs smoothly, we could say." "Even if it is like that, I simply have not learned for handicrafts." "A bunch of Turks who fight with all means to survive. Is that the new “Avatar” or an ÖVP party congress?"
